title: Blue Hour and Undertow
author: Vesper Reyes
blurb: Rosalind Winterbourne, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
